file:entrypoints/background.ts.name: background.ts
file:entrypoints/background.ts.summary: Registers the browser context-menu action, saves the selected page through the API, and presents save-result notifications.

file:entrypoints/popup/App.css.name: App.css
file:entrypoints/popup/App.css.summary: Provides the popup's complete component styling, including sign-in, dashboard, link-card, filtering, and responsive states.

file:entrypoints/popup/App.tsx.name: App.tsx
file:entrypoints/popup/App.tsx.summary: Owns popup authentication state, renders either sign-in or dashboard UI, and uses cached profile data to reduce popup startup latency.

file:entrypoints/popup/components/Dashbo.name: Dashboard.tsx
file:entrypoints/popup/components/Dashbo.summary: Implements the signed-in link-management dashboard with cached loading, saves, edits, deletion, search, date filtering, and clipboard actions.

file:entrypoints/popup/components/EmptyS.name: EmptyState.tsx
file:entrypoints/popup/components/EmptyS.summary: Renders the reusable empty-state illustration and copy used when there are no saved links or no matching results.

file:entrypoints/popup/components/LinkCa.name: LinkCard.tsx
file:entrypoints/popup/components/LinkCa.summary: Renders an individual saved link with favicon fallbacks, title editing, opening, copying, and deletion confirmation.

file:entrypoints/popup/components/SignIn.name: SignIn.tsx
file:entrypoints/popup/components/SignIn.summary: Provides the Google sign-in interaction and translates common OAuth or backend failures into actionable popup messages.

file:entrypoints/popup/index.html.name: index.html
file:entrypoints/popup/index.html.summary: Supplies the HTML document shell that WXT uses to mount the extension popup application.

file:entrypoints/popup/main.tsx.name: main.tsx
file:entrypoints/popup/main.tsx.summary: Bootstraps the React popup by mounting the root App component and global stylesheet.

file:entrypoints/popup/style.css.name: style.css
file:entrypoints/popup/style.css.summary: Defines global CSS resets, typography, variables, and base styles for the popup UI.

file:lib/api.ts.name: api.ts
file:lib/api.ts.summary: Centralizes authenticated link API requests and parses the backend's data and error envelopes into typed client results.

file:lib/auth.ts.name: auth.ts
file:lib/auth.ts.summary: Wraps Chrome Identity and storage APIs for OAuth tokens, cached user profiles, sign-out, and backend profile retrieval.

file:lib/config.ts.name: config.ts
file:lib/config.ts.summary: Exports the extension API base URL from the build-time environment configuration.

file:lib/search.ts.name: search.ts
file:lib/search.ts.summary: Implements client-side fuzzy text search, relevance ranking, and date-range filtering for saved links.

config:package.json.name: package.json
config:package.json.summary: Defines the extension package metadata, WXT build scripts, and React/TypeScript development dependencies.

file:server/index.js.summary: Composes the Express API with CORS, JSON parsing, health checks, link and user routers, and centralized error handling; it starts the listener for local use.

file:server/middleware/auth.js.name: auth.js
file:server/middleware/auth.js.summary: Validates bearer tokens against Google's user-info endpoint and attaches the authenticated account to the request.

file:server/models/Link.js.name: Link.js
file:server/models/Link.js.summary: Defines the Mongoose link document, ownership fields, input-size limits, timestamps, and per-user URL uniqueness index.

config:server/package.json.summary: Defines backend service metadata, Node development commands, tests, and Express/Mongoose dependencies.
